shared_elements: human figure in profile, striding, bearded, wearing headgear
quadruped animal in profile with legs shown striding
figures arranged in a single horizontal register on a ground line
low-relief profile composition with all figures facing the same direction
decorative border band at the base
justification: Both show a horizontal frieze of profile figures striding on a ground line, combining a bearded, capped human figure with a large quadruped rendered in profile with carefully articulated legs and hooves/paws, in a comparable naturalistic low-relief convention with anatomical detail. The decisive difference is that B's beings are hybrid and winged (bird-headed lion-body, horned-helmeted winged man with weapon) and are juxtaposed without interaction, whereas A shows a naturalistic burden animal being led by a human attendant holding its lead, above a rosette border, i.e. a tribute/procession relationship rather than a pair of supernatural guardians.
